headline: Marcos Tells LGUs to Enforce No-Build Zones More Strictly After Floods
seoTitle: Marcos Pushes Stricter No-Build Zone Enforcement | FMB News
seoDescription: President Marcos is urging LGUs to enforce no-build zones more strictly and strengthen local flood-risk measures after recent severe flooding.
deck: Malacañang says President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. wants stricter enforcement of no-build zones and related local measures to reduce flooding and climate-related risk.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. urged local governments to enforce existing no-build-zone policies more strictly as the administration reviewed recent flooding and climate-related risks.
The Palace said the push also includes clearing waterways, strengthening waste management and improving local measures intended to reduce flood exposure.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The directive followed a government response meeting on August 31 as severe flooding affected communities across parts of Luzon. No-build zones are intended to keep new structures out of locations identified as unsafe or environmentally sensitive under applicable laws and local rules.

sections.heading: Why this matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: Stronger enforcement could affect construction, property use and eventually relocation decisions in communities identified as high risk. The practical impact will depend on accurate hazard mapping, local implementation, notice and assistance for affected residents.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for written implementing guidance, updated hazard maps, specific LGU actions, relocation or assistance programs and clarification of how existing structures will be handled. The September 1 announcement should not be read as an immediate nationwide eviction order.
